title: inspect_ia_agents recette -- MAF multi-agent handoff run
description: What a multi-agent handoff orchestration ACTUALLY did: the ordered handoff hops between participants plus each participant's tool invocations. Judged by recette.maf_orchestration.judge_orchestration against the sibling team.json on the four dimensions. Deterministic (I4): a hop to a target outside the source's declared set is the recette analog of the framework's 'attempted to handoff to unknown target' ValueError.

agent_id.description: Must match the orchestration agent_id in the sibling team.json.

hops.description: Handoff-style runs: ordered transfers of control between participants.

reason.description: The declared reason for this transfer (why the source handed off). Display/audit metadata only: never a judge input.

order.description: Sequential/concurrent runs: the participants that actually executed, in execution order (sequential) or fan-out/aggregation order (concurrent).

actions.description: Tool invocations performed by participants during the run.

provider.description: Identity actually used (may differ from declared, I3).

approved.description: Whether approval was obtained before invocation (I6).
